typographie_suggestion.explanation: The text features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and unbracketed, hairline serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (popularized by Didot and Bodoni), which was the standard for official French printing in the late 19th century.
